At long last, I can don my robe AND my wizard hat.

progress.text: <Magus Tirth begins to cast Polymorph: Chicken on you.>

accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Turtle Scale Breastplate, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>

objectives.text: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.

accept.text:
Either dominant centaur clan is likely to pose a good ally, but I ought to offer a word of caution regarding the Gelkis.

I have trustworthy intel that suggests, between the Magram and the Gelkis, the latter are very much on the losing side. This may work to our advantage--desperation may push the isolated clan into opening up to outside help.

I have prepared a tote of totems for you to take to their quartermaster, assuming they have one, in Gelkis Village. This may work in our favor.

complete.text:
<Molkar peeks into the bag. A smirk tugs at his lips, falling only briefly as he catches a glimpse of a clearly fake totem. He pretends to not see it.>

I do not know what possessed an outsider to bring our clan such a gift. It is a great boon for our people, as the Magram Clan have been unusually vicious as of late.

You no longer need to tread carefully in our village. I will inform Uthek, who will speak with the Khan.

objectives.text: Bring the Totem Tote to the Gelkis Quartermaster at Gelkis Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan.  You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Gelkis Clan Centaur.

progress.text: An outsider this deep in the village? You best be bringing business.

accept.text:
<A handwritten label appears on the side of the crate. On the right side is a map with a large red circle along a southeastern shoreline north of a poorly drawn temple surrounded by water and some kind of winged creatures. On the left is a note in massive font.>

PROPERTY OF FRIZ FRAZZLESPARK

POWDERFUSE PORT

WARNING: NOT for tampering. Do NOT open without supervision.

<An additional note appears at the bottom of the label.>

If lost, return to Friz Frazzlespark. Powderfuse Port. Riverglades.

objectives.text: Deliver the Lost Shipping Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.

accept.text:
While war rages throughout the region, the Maraudine centaur stand unchallenged in the Valley of Spears. I worry that they will grow callous in time and stir further unrest if the other clans continue to turn a blind eye to their presence.

Khan Hratha possesses a Maraudine Key Fragment, and I wish to have it as a negotiation tactic. Find a war horn mouthpiece from the centaur there and use it to challenge him atop the highest peak.

Bring the key to me, and I will have a proposition for you.

objectives.text: Bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Umarak in the Desolace.

accept.text:
The ancient Gurubashi of Stranglethorn Vale were da masters of dark blood magics. Rumors be they'd use pure truesilver idols to channel that bad bad voodoo.

Ol' Mazu'kon would love to get his hands on one of those idols... for academics ya see. How 'bout you gather some friends and do a bit of smash and grab on that drowned city stickin' out the ocean off the coast of Stranglethorn? Kill the most impressive lookin' priest ya can find in there, and they sure to have what I be lookin' for.

objectives.text: Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.

accept.text:
Orgrimmar is always expanding, $c. And when the peons need hides to line the walls and roofs of our new buildings, they come to me!

The hides of the lizards in Thunder Ridge are typically too thick for armor, but they make excellent building material. Bring me some of their hides, along with a few lighter cured hides. Let's see your skill with leather!

objectives.text: Kamari in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Rough Lizard Hide from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 2 Cured Light Hides.

accept.text:
You may not have our best interests at heart, but I won't deny an extra pair of hands. And if Dalaran falls, it takes everything with it--including your Undercity.

So, your benefactor wants in? Fine. I'll imbue your key to work past my wards so you can enter the city. Once you're in, meet me at the Violet Citadel where this all began. With everything going on the Kirin Tor will be too busy to stop you.

Scavenge what you will, but whatever happens, our first priority is to prevent a catastrophe.

complete.text:
Oh my, a shade of the archmage? How utterly embarrassing for them.

And the Kirin Tor allowed you into their inner chambers? Interesting. This could provide an opportunity...

objectives.text: Collect the Arcane Mote in the City of Dalaran for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.

progress.text: You were right to come straight back to me. Have you found anything in Dalaran?

accept.text:
Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.

I care not for the fate of the mage city, $n, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.

complete.text: Excellent work. That beast is unworthy to walk among the dead. Let him lie beneath them.

objectives.text: Defeat Atrexis the Grave Knight in the City of Dalaran for Melisara in Tarren Mill.

accept.text:
Well if it ain't a like-minded entrepreneur. Sneakin' into Dalaran durin' such troublesome times? Tsk tsk.

My kinda $r!

While our mage friends here are occupied, maybe we could find ourselves some 'misplaced' treasures. They gots whole libraries dedicated to fancy arcane magics. If you could bring me one of their secret tomes, I could sell it for a pretty penny. Split the profits with ya.

Hey hey don't look at me like that. You ain't exactly here on a field trip yourself. You want in or what?

Well if it ain't a like-minded entrepreneur. Sneakin' into Dalaran durin' such troublesome times? Tsk tsk.

My kinda skyborne!

While our mage friends here are occupied, maybe we could find ourselves some 'misplaced' treasures. They gots whole libraries dedicated to fancy arcane magics. If you could bring me one of their secret tomes, I could sell it for a pretty penny. Split the profits with ya.

Hey hey don't look at me like that. You ain't exactly here on a field trip yourself. You want in or what?

complete.text:
I guess I shouldn't have sent a stooge to look for priceless artifacts. This is barely worth sellin' at a tourist kiosk! What, did you just grab the first book that seemed to be jutting out from the rest?

Forget it. Maybe I can spray it with gold and say it belonged to an arch mage or somethin'.

objectives.text: Collect the Founding of Dalaran from the City of Dalaran for Rexxie Copperclutch near the sewer entrance.

progress.text: Well? Didja find their library? There's gotta be somethin' good in there.

accept.text:
With the city of Dalaran under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.

Imagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?

Go to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.

complete.text:
Cracked. Cracked. CRACKED.

I can't make use of any of these! I said disable the sentries, not obliterate them! How dangerous could they have been?

My dreams of magus abominations are at a standstill. For now.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Cracked Sentry Cores in the City of Dalaran for Doctor Martin Felben in Undercity.

progress.text: The value in these cores is that they are powerful. The downside is that means the constructs are powerful. Good luck.

accept.text:
There is a servant of the Lich King that makes his home deep in the Death's Head quilboar lair known as Razorfen Downs. It is known to us that he makes use of a scrying orb to observe and direct the movements of his minions elsewhere.

With this artifact, we'd be able to hunt down the covert agents of the Scourge and put an end to them and the threat they pose to Kalimdor forever.

Go into Razorfen Downs to the lair of Amnennar the Coldbringer and retrieve the orb known as the Coldbringer's Eye for me.

objectives.text: Recover The Coldbringer's Eye from Razorfen Downs.

accept.text:
Ever strike a deal with a satyr, mon?

I have. How could I resist? The promise of power, knowledge far exceeding what any ordinary tome could offer... all alongside an eager and charismatic minion. What more could I ask for?

Bah, of course they would never bend the knee to a mortal. I bargained when I had nothing, only to be cast aside with even less.

Now, I want revenge. Revenge against the Hatefury. Raid their camp to the northeast! Stain the dirt with their foul blood.

complete.text:
I wish I had been able to watch your battles unfold and hear their wretched screams as they fell to your might.

But one of them surely eluded your slaughter. The one whose hand I shook in a ritual of spilled blood. So long as he roams the Desolace, I cannot risk stepping foot outside of Shadowprey. He would soon find me again, and with my soulstone in his possession... not even death would be an escape.

Eventually, I will have it back. But for now, your work is done.

objectives.text: Defeat a variety of Hatefury satyr at Sargeron in Desolace and then return to Aka'rai in Shadowprey Village.

accept.text:
You have done well to infiltrate the city of mages, but I believe it is time for us to be more... negotiatory.

As much as it pains me to admit, there is no other place on Azeroth with such a vast knowledge of the arcane. My brilliant work still pales in comparison to the ancient wisdom the Kirin Tor have amassed over the years. I think it's high time we are granted access to this exclusive order, don't you think?

Take the mote you acquired. They will surely give anything to get it back. Anything.

complete.text:
You would give this... willingly?

I do not know your game, $r, but I cannot deny the value of your interference during this delicate time for our people. It's not within my power to grant you access to the city at this time, but someday... perhaps. For now, our thanks will have to suffice.

objectives.text: Speak with the Image of Archmage Modera near Dalaran.

progress.text: Oh, you are back.

accept.text:
<As you sift through the debris left behind by a horrible zeppelin crash directly above, you find evidence of a hefty shipment of supplies that has long since been plundered of all its value. Even the shipping labels have been torn and shredded, leaving only the words 'Booty Bay' barely legible on one.

Countless two-toed footprints and several patches of divotted earth all lead toward ruins in the northwest.>

objectives.text: Recover $1oa Stolen Shipments from the Ruins of Zul'Kunda in Stranglethorn Vale and return your haul to someone in Booty Bay.

accept.text:
Pleasure to make yer acquaintance! Name's Borgus, of the one and only Steelhand family. You can always count on a Steelhand fer a fair deal!

A few weeks back me brother Gorbold joined up with a merchant stall in Auberdine. Plenty of coin to be made supplyin' ships there, let me tell you! Lucky sod.

I haven't heard from him since--mind checking on him if yer heading that way?

There's a new ship in the harbor that will take ye straight there. Head to the southern-most dock; can't miss it!

objectives.text:
Check on Gorbold Steelhand in Auberdine in Darkshore.

Borgus mentioned a boat on the southern-most dock in Stormwind Harbor that can take you there.

accept.text:
Fascinating, aren't they? This is the first time I have ever been privy to the secrets of abomination creation.

I have been studying these notes, and it appears we need a heart. A massive one!

I hear there is a thunder lizard there of impressive size called Stormheart, that patrols along the canyon edge in Thousand Needles. With a name like that it must have the perfect heart. I must have that heart!

Oh, also I suggest you bring friends. Stormheart isn't known for being docile.

complete.text:
Excellent! I can hardly contain my excitement. Oh, and the heart still has electrical pulses? That's impressive. I won't have to shock it back to life then!

This heart will be a wonderful addition to the abomination, and certainly looks to be the specified size, if these notes are correct.

Ah, I love it when a plan comes together.

objectives.text: Slay Stormheart in Thousand Needles and acquire its heart.

progress.text: Oh, you've returned in one piece! Pity, if you hadn't your flesh and organs would have made excellent fodder for my tinkering.

accept.text:
Those wretched harpies! They attacked the last caravan I had scheduled to deliver supplies to Freewind Post. We have enough supplies for the moment, but without more supplies, we'll run short soon.

I'm not sure what the harpies plan to do with the extra supplies, but I would be grateful if you would recover them for me. They make their lair west of here. They can be found both at the base of the cliffside and inside a cave at the top.

complete.text: Thank you, $N. These supplies will help get us through until the next shipment arrives.

objectives.text: Bring 8 Stolen Freewind Supplies to Jandia in Freewind Post.

progress.text: Have you been able to recover the supplies the harpies stole?

accept.text:
The Screeching Canyon is home to a local band of harpies known for their ferocious nature and raiding tactics. They have ambushed the last few supply caravans that have been brave enough to traverse this place.

I fear if something isn't done soon, there will be no caravans that will dare make the trek to Freewind Post.

Go, slay as many of these harpies as you are able. Return to me once the deed has been done, and I will reward you well for your efforts.

complete.text: This is wonderful news! I will send word to our suppliers that the harpies have been dealt with. At least that is one less threat the future caravans will need to worry about.

objectives.text: Slay $1oa Screeching Harpies, $2oa Screeching Roguefeather Harpies and $3oa Screeching Windcaller Harpies.

accept.text:
<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Property of the Azeroth Commerce Authority. Please return empty crates or unfulfilled shipments to our local trade hub at the Three Corners crossroads in Redridge Mountains. Couriers will be compensated for their time and travel."

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>

complete.text:
You have arrived at the right place! I am happy to mark you down as one of our affiliates. No contracts to sign and no commitments to weigh you down. All we ask of you is your diligence to assist in completing or returning any of our deliveries you find on your travels.

When you do so, you will be compensated with Merchant's Favor that will allow you to purchase goods and services we offer here. In fact, here's a little bit to get you started.

Now, do you happen to have the crate this came from?

objectives.text: Deliver the Shipping Label to someone at the Azeroth Commerce Authority trade hub in Redridge Mountains.

progress.text: Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?

complete.text:
The deceased Night Watchman lying before you is covered in deep gashes and cuts. It's clear to see that he was mauled by some sort of large beast.

You notice that the corpse has an unlit torch in his hand. You reach down and pry it from his stiff fingers. This could be useful in your travels through Duskwood and beyond to reveal things hidden by darkness.

accept.text:
If the gnolls are growing so bold they are willing to camp this close to humans, there's no telling how much further they'll go. We need to deter them.

The beasts are hardly organized, but they seem to respect strength above all else. If we can slay the worst of them, maybe claim some of their trophies, we can remind these gnolls why they should stay in the hills where they belong.

Should you see any of their thrashers, bring me their collars. That should put the fear of the Alliance back into them.

complete.text:
Quite the armful you have.

While this doesn't solve our problem out here, I can rest comfortably knowing we've discouraged them pushing any further. Great work, $N.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Spiked Collars from Redridge Thrashers for Deputy Feldon near Lakeshire.

progress.text: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
